changelog:
Initial release of the 代码审查器 (code-reviewer) skill:

- Provides comprehensive code review: checks for code conventions, potential bugs, performance issues, and security vulnerabilities.
- Outputs reports with prioritized suggestions (P0, P1, P2) and mandatory fixes for critical (P0) issues.
- Analyzes project structure, quality items (like null checks, exception handling, hard-coded secrets), and security risks.
- Delivers results as a markdown code review report named according to project.
- Supports modular audit for large projects and requires actionable recommendations for every issue found.
summary: 代码审查与质量检测：检查代码规范、潜在Bug、性能问题、安全漏洞，输出审查报告与改进建议。Invoke when user asks 代码审查、Code Review、代码质量、代码检查、代码优化.
